Definition: from, G5187; opaque (as if smoky), i.e. (by analogy) blind (physically or mentally):--blind.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, typhlós means blind. In Matthew 9:27, two blind men followed him, and it appears again in Mark 8:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe typhlós still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
